description:
Gong, who was recently discharged from the military and was on the run with his girlfriend (who he had been seeing for a month), who had a lot of debt. He was caught having sex with his girlfriend when he let his guard down. Soo, who had been collecting money from debt collectors, offers this poor couple a choice, saying, “Do you want to pay it back in one night? Or do you want to pay it back slowly over the course of fifty years?” 

If you don’t have sex, you can’t get out (alive)! And you have to sleep with a man you’ve never met before!
